name: Infosys

roles.name: Systems Engineer (Trainee)
roles.note: Mass-hiring role. Infosys's ESG report says campus hires (System Engineering Trainees, DSEs, SPs) go through a 19–23 week Foundation Program at the Global Education Center, Mysore.

roles.name: Digital Specialist Engineer (DSE)
roles.note: Higher-tier role selected through a coding-based assessment; secondary sources commonly cite ~₹6.25 LPA.

roles.name: Specialist Programmer (SP)
roles.note: Listed by Infosys as a graduate role for in-depth programming. Also reachable via HackWithInfy pre-placement interviews. Package figures vary widely across sources.

rounds.name: Online Test (Systems Engineer)
rounds.what_they_check: Reasoning, quantitative ability, English and computational thinking (pseudocode output, puzzles). Several secondary sources agree on the 15/10/20/5/4 question split; section timings vary slightly between sources, and the total is reported as ~100 minutes. Sectional and overall cutoffs are reported.
prep: Practise data-sufficiency, arrangements and syllogism sets for Reasoning (the hardest section per many candidates).
Mathematical Ability has few questions but long time: practise multi-step word problems, P&C and probability.
Practise tracing pseudocode output for loops, recursion and bitwise operators.
Do timed verbal sets (sentence correction, reading comprehension) to protect the verbal sectional cutoff.

rounds.name: Coding Assessment (SP / DSE)
rounds.what_they_check: Problem-solving and algorithmic depth. Most secondary sources describe 3 problems of increasing difficulty (easy/medium/hard) in 3 hours; a December 2025 candidate report mentions 4 problems in 180 minutes, so the count is left unknown.
prep: Practise medium-level DSA: greedy, two pointers, binary search, prefix sums, graphs (BFS/DFS).
Learn dynamic programming patterns (knapsack, LIS, grid DP) for the hardest problem.
Aim to fully pass the easier problems first, then attempt partial solutions on the hard one.
Practise under a 3-hour timer to build stamina.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.what_they_check: Your project, one programming language, OOP, DBMS and DSA basics (per secondary guides). SP/DSE interviews go deeper into coding and, for DSE, digital/emerging-tech topics.
prep: Revise OOP concepts with code examples in your chosen language.
Practise SQL queries and explain normalization and keys.
Be ready to code or dry-run a simple problem live and explain its complexity.

rounds.name: HR Interview
rounds.what_they_check: Communication, attitude, flexibility on location and training, and fit. Sources say an HR round happens in some drives and is sometimes merged with the technical round.
prep: Prepare answers on relocating to Mysuru for the Foundation Program and later to any project location.
Research Infosys's business and training model so 'Why Infosys?' sounds specific.

cutoffs.note: Not published; Infosys does not release official cutoffs. Secondary sources say both sectional and overall cutoffs exist. One prep site projects ~70–72% overall for the SE track, but labels it a projection, and older candidate reports cite lower figures, so no single number is given here.

cse_it.note: SE test includes pseudocode; SP/DSE require the coding assessment. CSE/IT candidates are expected to target SP/DSE and should be strong in DSA.

ece_eee.note: Eligible for SE (confirm branch list in your drive notice). Pseudocode and basic programming are tested for everyone; SP/DSE still require the full coding assessment.

mech_civil.note: Typically eligible for SE (confirm in notice). Focus on aptitude, pseudocode and one language; Infosys trains hires in its Foundation Program.

all.note: Secondary sources commonly cite 60% or 6.0 CGPA throughout and no active backlogs; one guide reports 65% for graduation. Eligibility can vary by college and drive.

jd_skills.note: Pseudocode section in the online test.
One programming language in depth (Java, Python, C/C++ all used by candidates).
DBMS and SQL basics in technical interview.
Expect detailed questions on your project.
DSE is described as focused on digital/full-stack work.
One source lists InfyTQ as preferred for SP; not an official requirement.

hr_focus: Willingness to relocate to Mysuru for the Foundation Program and then to any location.
Why Infosys and which role (SE/DSE/SP) fits you.
Learning attitude for a long training program and new technologies.
